provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench development fixture; no external theme copied.
runtime_subset: Core Liquid section body rendered after AST-verified extraction of one unchanged top-level schema; supplied section hash, no Shopify lifecycle/defaults.
prompt: Add optional subtitle output to sections/announcement.liquid while preserving existing behavior. All input keys are supplied: section.id is a string; section.settings.enabled and show_body are booleans; heading and body are strings; subtitle is null or a string. If enabled is false output no elements or non-whitespace text. Otherwise keep exactly one section with class announcement and escaped data-section-id matching section.id; its children, in order, must be: h2 with escaped heading unchanged; p with class announcement__subtitle only when subtitle trimmed of surrounding ASCII whitespace is nonempty, containing that trimmed escaped text; p with class announcement__body only if show_body is true, containing escaped body unchanged. No extra elements or attributes. Preserve the entire existing schema block byte-for-byte; its subtitle setting already exists. Change only this section file. Do not hardcode values or disable checks. Use core Liquid empty comparison instead of Shopify blank. For a visible body render, pass strip_schema:true to render; this extracts metadata and supplies hashes, it does not emulate Shopify section objects or default settings. Whitespace between elements and quote style are unrestricted.
